title: Who Should Verify? Reviewer Selection with Partial Information and Outcome Audits
abstract: arXiv:2611.26770v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Selecting an AI reviewer requires evidence about what it does after reading a draft. On a fixed batch of items, a team can keep the original answers or adopt one reviewer's answers throughout. We ask how much it costs to certify that the chosen procedure falls at most a specified number of correct answers short of the best available procedure, for every completion of the unobserved evidence. When all reviews are available and only verified answer keys cost money, we give an exact stopping rule and an integer program for the cheapest certificate in hindsight. When reviews and keys both have prices, a polynomial-time algorithm using the completed record approximates the minimum certificate cost within a factor logarithmic in the number of procedures. translated_title: 谁来验证？基于部分信息与结果审计的审阅者选择
translated_abstract: 选择AI审阅者需要证据来了解它在阅读草稿后会做什么。在固定的一批条目上，团队可以保留原始答案，或者全程采用某一位审阅者的答案。我们要问：对于未观测证据的每一种可能补全情况，认证“所选程序与最佳可用程序相比至多落后指定数量的正确答案”需要花费多少成本。当所有审阅均可获取且只有经验证的答案密钥需要付费时，我们给出了一个精确的停止规则，以及一个用于事后计算最便宜证书的整数规划。当审阅与答案密钥均有价格时，我们提出一种利用已完成记录的多项式时间算法，可将最小证书成本近似到程序数量的对数因子以内。除非P等于NP，这种对数依赖在主阶上是紧的。寻找证书的成本可能要高得多。我们展示了一个包含 $n$ 个未决条目的双程序家族，其中一次购买……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文研究部分信息下的审阅者选择问题，提出了认证所选策略至多落后最优策略指定差距的最低成本证书方法——在仅答案密钥付费时给出精确停止规则与整数规划，在审阅与密钥均付费时给出对数因子的多项式时间近似算法，并证明除非P=NP该对数依赖是紧的。
en_tdlr: The paper studies reviewer selection under partial information, providing an exact stopping rule and integer program for the cheapest certificate when only verified answer keys cost money, a polynomial-time algorithm achieving a logarithmic-factor approximation when reviews also have prices, and proving this logarithmic dependence is tight unless P equals NP.
